generations.name: First generation (e-tron)
generations.notes: e-tron 55 quattro, e-tron Sportback (from MY2020) and e-tron S / S Sportback (MY2022-2023): 95 kWh gross pack, 83.6 kWh usable at launch, 86.5 kWh usable after the 2020 update, 150 kW DC, 400 V. The smaller e-tron 50 (71 kWh) was not sold in North America. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audi_Q8_e-tron

generations.name: Q8 e-tron (facelift)
generations.notes: Facelift and rename: Q8 e-tron / Q8 Sportback e-tron and SQ8: 114 kWh gross / 106 kWh usable, 170 kW DC. The Q8 e-tron 50 (95 kWh) was not sold here. Production ended February 2025; MY2025 is the last. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audi_Q8_e-tron
